description:
Specialized contract for HYCOM (Hybrid Coordinate Ocean Model) datasets.
Distinguishes OPeNDAP-served z-levels vs native hybrid coordinate layers.

native_layer_count.description: Number of vertical coordinate layers in native hybrid system (default 41 for modern GOFS/ESPC).
native_layer_count.title: Native Layer Count

served_depth_levels_count.description: Number of standard depth levels if served as interpolated z-levels (e.g. 40 levels).
served_depth_levels_count.title: Served Depth Levels Count

surface_salinity_reference.description: Reference salinity for equation of state.
surface_salinity_reference.title: Surface Salinity Reference

uses_fast_thermodynamics.description: Indicates whether 17-term polynomial equation of state is employed.
uses_fast_thermodynamics.title: Uses Fast Thermodynamics

vertical_representation.description: Classification of vertical coordinate output structure.

title: HYCOMModelContract
